issues.title: How does Trump's defeat in US midterms impact Indian stock market? Explained
issues.brief_summary: Hours after reported U.S. strikes hit Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz, Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian warned that resuming war benefits “no one,” as U.S. voters headed to the polls for midterm elections threatening President Trump’s power. Indian equities are already contending with a range of domestic market pressures.
issues.summary_100: Hours after reported U.S. strikes hit Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz, Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian warned that resuming war benefits “no one,” as U.S. voters headed to the polls for midterm elections threatening President Trump’s power. Indian equities are already contending with a range of domestic market pressures. Uncertainty surrounding Donald Trump's tariff decisions, higher crude oil prices and bond yields, along with sustained foreign institutional investor (FII) selling, has pushed the Sensex and Nifty down. In this environment, investors are watching the US midterm elections for clues about their possible impact on global financial markets.
